Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/opensc && nl -ba src/libopensc/pkcs15-algo.c | sed -n '240,340p;430,460p' && python3 - <<'PY'
import re,pathlib
for p in pathlib.Path('src').rglob('*.c'):
 s=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
 # approximate local arrays and copy templates count incl unsized
 for m in re.finditer(r'sc_copy_asn1_entry\((c_asn1_\w+),\s*(\w+)\)', s):
  tmpl,dest=m.groups(); pre=s[:m.start()]
  decls=list(re.finditer(r'(?:struct\s+)?sc_asn1_entry\s+([^;]*\b'+re.escape(dest)+r'\s*\[([^\]]+)\][^;]*);', pre))
  if decls:
   line=s.count('\n',0,m.start())+1
   print(p,line,tmpl,'->',dest,'decl:',decls[-1].group(0).replace('\n',' ')[:160])
PY
